title: Operator Notices Standing Against a Vacation Package: the Combinations and What Each Yields
content:
Where more than one operator notice stands against a package among the Vacation Package Products, the rate advised for one traveller is read from the notices on the following combinations. A notice advises no surcharge where the amount it advises is nil or less; it advises a surcharge where the amount it advises is above nil.

## The combinations

| The notice posted latest against the package | An earlier notice standing against the package advising a surcharge above nil | What is taken as the rate advised for one traveller |
| --- | --- | --- |
| advises no surcharge | there is one | the amount advised by the latest notice that did advise a surcharge |
| advises no surcharge | there is none | nil |
| advises a surcharge above nil | either way | no substitution of the notice is made |

**First combination.** Where the operator notice posted latest against the package advises no surcharge and an earlier notice standing against the package advises a surcharge above nil, the amount advised by the latest notice that did advise a surcharge is taken as the rate. The notice consulted is then the latest by posting date among those that advised a surcharge above nil, and not the latest of all notices.

**Second combination.** Where the operator notice posted latest against the package advises no surcharge and no earlier notice standing against the package advises a surcharge above nil, the rate is nil.

**Third combination.** Where the notice posted latest against the package itself advises a surcharge above nil, no substitution of the notice is made on this ground.

## On the boundary

An amount of exactly nil on the latest notice is an amount of nil or less, so such a notice advises no surcharge and the first two combinations are the ones in play. An amount of 0.01 USD on the latest notice is above nil, so that notice advises a surcharge and the third combination is the one in play.

*Hypothetically.* A package carries three notices: one posted in March advising 60.00 USD, one posted in April advising 25.00 USD, and one posted in May advising 0.00 USD. The latest advises no surcharge, and an earlier one advises a surcharge above nil, so the first combination governs; the latest notice that did advise a surcharge is the April one, and 25.00 USD is taken as the rate advised for one traveller.
